description: The pie chart, titled "Stimulus Type," displays the distribution of various types of stimuli used in a study, with each category represented by a colored segment and labeled with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored dark red, represents "Draft/Other" at 26.4%. The second largest is "Press Release" at 18.7%, shown in a gold color, followed by "External News Article" at 18.1%, which is depicted in a dark green. Other categories include "Interview" (8.8%, dark blue), "Organizational Report" (7.7%, purple), "Event Posting" (6.6%, brown), "Organizational Website" (4.9%, light blue), and "Intra-agency news article" (4.9%, dark grey). The smallest segments are "Email" (2.7%, light green) and "Social Media Post" (1.1%, very light brown). The chart uses a ring design with the labels and percentages clearly indicated outside the ring, and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest segment positioned at the top right.
